text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Increased gRPC stream failures for inference endpoints in az1a. Alerting p95 gRPC errors > 5% for 5m. Investigating.
jamie_ops: on it. pulling logs.
eng_vik: seeing partial DNS resolver responses from 10.0.0.2 in az1a, some queries return truncated answers. Could be resolver headroom exhaustion.
sre_liz: confirmed. KV cache miss rate spiked, downstream gRPC reconnect storms. Increasing resolver client timeout to 2s and enabling backoff.
jamie_ops: doing a soft redirect to eu-west-1 for new sessions. Will patch route policy for inference-prod -> prefer eu-west-1 for 5m.
eng_vik: logs: ```grpc: stream error: rpc error: code = Internal desc = upstream closed connection
resolver: query id=0x7f overflow: truncated
``` 
jamie_ops: runbook step 2: `kubectl annotate svc inference-prod routing-preference=eu-west-1 --overwrite`
sre_liz: applied per-node DNS cache purge on az1a hosts: `systemd-resolve --flush-caches` and restarted local stub-resolver on 3 nodes.
eng_vik: still seeing ~30% fail for existing sessions (sticky sessions). planning kv-cache warmup after steer.
omar_cust: any ETA for customer requests? Some users seeing timeouts on embeddings.
jamie_ops: steer live; new traffic directed to eu-west-1, rolling restart of 6 pods to clear stuck streams. ETA 6-8 min.
deploy_bot: rolling-restart initiated for deployment/inference-prod by jamie_ops (6 pods)
eng_vik: temporary mitigation: enable gRPC retry on client side with exponential backoff + jitter. Pushing config in 2m.
sre_liz: created incident ticket INC-20250317-az1a-resolver, assigning postmortem. Noting possible resolver headroom + SYN backlog on stub-resolver.
jamie_ops: monitoring metrics: error pct dropping to 2% after steer :thumbsup:
omar_cust: thanks. will notify affected customers in 20m with status update.
incident_bot: incident severity downgraded to SEV3: external impact reduced. Keep thread open for 1h for followups.
